title: Keep the balance: solve a linear equation

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: An equation works like a balance scale. Solving it means finding the x that keeps it level.

do.text: Find the $x$ that keeps it level.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Solve for x: three x plus twelve equals thirty-nine.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Each bag holds the same unknown, x.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Each square is one.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Undo the plus twelve first.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Take twelve off both pans.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Still level. Three bags balance twenty-seven.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Now divide both sides by three: share the twenty-seven into three equal piles, one for each bag.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Each bag balances nine. x equals nine.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Check: three nines plus twelve make thirty-nine.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Solve six x plus one equals five x plus twelve.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Now x is on both sides.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Take five bags off both pans at once.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Still level: one bag and one square balance twelve.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Then take one square off both pans.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: One bag balances eleven. x equals eleven.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Next, two x plus six equals two x plus nine.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The right pan has three more, so it sinks.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Let x grow. Let it shrink. The right pan stays down.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Take two bags off both pans: six against nine.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: A common slip is to call nine the answer, but x is gone, and nothing can level these pans.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: There is no solution.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Last, two x plus six equals two x plus six.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Let x grow. Let it shrink. The pans stay level.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Take two bags off both pans: six against six.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Every number works: infinitely many solutions in all.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: x alone against a number means one solution.

do.text: $x$ alone against a number: one solution.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Never level, like six and nine, means no solution.

do.text: Never level, like $6$ and $9$: no solution.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Always level, like six and six, means every number works.

do.text: Always level, like $6$ and $6$: every number.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Same thing to both sides. Undo until x stands alone.
